text: At 65 minutes, Seabrook Town amped up their game plan by pressing higher and playing more directly to catch Harbour City off guard while chasing a 2-1 scoreline[#1361]. They tried to push forward quicker and use their wings more, but surprisingly, their expected chances to score actually dropped a bit, from 0.56 to 0.47—meaning their chances looked less likely to result in goals[#1361]. Harbour City stuck to their calm, short passes and kept things tight at the back, cutting down Seabrook’s control of the field from about 71% to 46%[#1361]. So far, Seabrook’s new tactic is energetic but hasn’t broken through Harbour City’s defense yet[#1361].
